query: MATCH (sp:Spec) WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber OPTIONAL MATCH (s1:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:specNumber}), (s1)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(s2:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:specNumber}) RETURN specNumber,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s1 IS NOT NULL AND s2 IS NOT NULL THEN [s1,s2] ELSE null END) AS intraRefs ORDER BY intraRefs DESC,specNumber ASC LIMIT 5
